File a police report if required and notify the IRS if tax fraud is involved. Keep detailed records of all communications and follow guidance from consumer-protection agencies to restore your credit and identity.

Creators and distributors can balance protection and usability by combining approaches: clear licensing and watermarking (visible or forensic) deter misuse while preserving usability; subscription or ad-supported models provide affordable, convenient legal access; flexible licensing (offline periods, device limits) reduces friction; and streaming with server-side access control minimizes exposure of raw files. Best practices include educating audiences about legal options, pricing fairly to lower incentives for piracy, ensuring accessibility for assistive technologies, and choosing transparent, reversible protections. In many cases, fostering easy, legal distribution channels and good user experience reduces piracy more effectively than heavy-handed technical restrictions alone.

benign_query: What are SQL injection and cross-site scripting vulnerabilities, and how can developers prevent them and pursue ethical bug-hunting?
